name: Super Video Player – Play Self-Hosted MP4 or OGG Videos
author: bPlugins

sections.description:
Super Video Player is a fast, fully customizable, and lightweight HTML5 video player plugin for WordPress. Whether you’re embedding a single MP4 file, offering multilingual subtitles, or building a video playlist with multiple quality options, this plugin puts you in control.

Super Video Player | Documentation | Pricing | Support | Demo

Designed with performance, accessibility, and flexibility in mind, Super Video Player supports self-hosted MP4, OGG, HLS (.m3u8), and DASH (.mpd) formats. It’s responsive, works with all major browsers (including older ones like IE7–9), and is packed with customization options. Add videos using a shortcode or insert them directly with the built-in Gutenberg block.

Perfect for bloggers, educators, digital marketers, and content creators who want clean, accessible video playback without relying on third-party platforms.

Key Features – Free Version

  • Self-hosted HTML5 video – Embed MP4, OGG, HLS (.m3u8), and DASH (.mpd) files.
  • Live stream support – Play real-time content using .m3u8 or .mpd sources.
  • VTT captions & subtitles – Full support for multiple subtitle tracks in different languages.
  • Screen reader compatible – Designed with accessibility standards in mind.
  • Custom player markup – Modify the HTML structure to match your theme (developer-friendly).
  • Compact and lightweight – Keeps your site fast and uncluttered.
  • Responsive design – Works flawlessly across all screen sizes and devices.
  • Cross-browser compatible – Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge, and even IE7–IE9.
  • Shortcode support – Insert the video player into any post, page, or widget.
  • Gutenberg block included – Easily add videos using the block editor.
  • Autoplay, mute, loop options – Configure playback behavior to fit your content.
  • Click-to-play/tap-to-play – Simple interaction for mobile and desktop users.
  • Picture-in-picture mode – Let viewers multitask while watching.
  • Unlimited video support – No restrictions on the number of videos you can add.
  • iOS-compatible – Seamless playback on Apple devices.
  • Great for video previews – Perfect for offering previews if you sell digital videos.

Super Video Player Pro – Unlock Premium Features

Take your video experience further with Super Video Player Pro, designed for creators who need more control, customization, and content delivery options.

What’s New in the Pro Version?

  • Create playlists – Add multiple videos and play them in sequence.
  • Video quality selector – Provide different resolutions for varied internet speeds.
  • Custom layout themes – Choose from multiple player designs and playlist formats.
  • Show/hide individual controls – Decide which buttons appear (volume, seek, fullscreen, etc.).
  • Initial volume setting – Set the default volume for each video.
  • Custom seek time – Define how many seconds the user skips forward or back.
  • Click-to-play toggle – Enable single-click play/pause on the video container.
  • Tooltips on/off – Add or remove control tooltips to guide user interaction.
  • Video title & description – Display detailed video info above or below the player.
  • Advanced styling – Customize the font, size, color, and alignment of titles and descriptions.
  • Poster images – Add custom thumbnails for single videos or playlist items.
  • Multiple captions – Include different subtitle tracks for multilingual audiences.
  • Multiple video qualities – Offer SD, HD, and more in one player.
  • Mobile-optimized playlist layout – Built to look great on every screen.
  • Playlist layout variations – Choose how your playlist appears on the page.
  • Playlist titles & descriptions – Add custom metadata to each video in your list.
  • Gutenberg block ready – Every Pro feature is available inside the block editor.

Upgrade to Pro and unlock all premium features today!

User Feedback

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ So simple to use. Excellent!

❛❛A very neat and efficient way of playing self-hosted videos via WordPress.❜❜

–jonthanr

How to Use Super Video Player – Quick Start Guide

Getting started is easy!

Follow these steps:

Step-by-Step Setup

  1. Install and activate the plugin.
  2. Go to the “Super Video Player” menu in your WordPress dashboard.
  3. Add a video by uploading or linking to your self-hosted file.
  4. Copy the auto-generated shortcode for the video.
  5. Paste it into any post, page, or widget to display the player.

Add Videos Using the Gutenberg Block

  1. Open any post or page using the block editor.
  2. Click the “+” icon to add a block.
  3. Search for “Super Video Player” under the Common block category.
  4. Select the block, choose your video from the dropdown, and configure the settings.
  5. Publish your content and enjoy!

Gutenberg Block Support

Super Video Player comes with a built-in Gutenberg block that makes it easy to add and configure videos without writing a single line of shortcode. All free and Pro features are fully supported inside the block editor, including:

  • Video selection from a dropdown
  • Autoplay, loop, and mute options
  • Playlist display with custom titles and descriptions
  • Poster image selection
  • Caption file upload and language labeling
  • Video quality selector
  • Full layout control

Live Demo | Try the Pro Version

sections.faq:
How do I install this plugin?

You can install as others regular wordpress plugin. No different way. Please see on installation tab.

What Video type can i play?

You can play mp4, ogg video file.

How many player i can publish in my site?

You can publish unlimited video with unlimited player.
